sources: arXiv API http://export.arxiv.org/api/query (Atom; search_query, start, max_results=1000, sortBy=submittedDate, sortOrder=ascending; one request every 3.2 s; User-Agent 'SpinDrift-literature-builder/1.0 (NASA Space Apps 2026 entry; arXiv API and NCBI E-utilities only)')

NCBI E-utilities https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi (db=pubmed, retmax=10000) and https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi (POST, rettype=medline, 400 PMIDs per request; tool=SpinDrift-literature-builder, no e-mail; at most one request every 0.4 s)

Device's own paper: Long, Zhang, Zhang & Zhang, 'Single quantum dot based nanosensor for renin assay', Anal. Chem. 84, 8846 (2012) (PMID:23003565); abstract only: the full text and Supporting Information are paywalled (pubs.acs.org)
arxiv query 'quantum_dot_fret': abs:"quantum dot" AND (abs:"energy transfer" OR abs:FRET)
arxiv query 'fret': abs:FRET
arxiv query 'single_molecule_fret': abs:"single-molecule" AND abs:FRET
arxiv query 'tirf': abs:"total internal reflection fluorescence" OR abs:TIRF
arxiv query 'cy5': abs:Cy5
arxiv query 'quantum_dots_bio': abs:"quantum dots" AND (abs:biological OR abs:imaging OR abs:biosensing OR abs:bioimaging)
arxiv query 'single_molecule_fluorescence': abs:"single molecule" AND abs:fluorescence

pubmed query 'quantum_dot_fret': "quantum dot*"[tiab] AND (FRET[tiab] OR "fluorescence resonance energy transfer"[tiab] OR "Forster resonance energy transfer"[tiab] OR "Förster resonance energy transfer"[tiab])
pubmed query 'protease_quantum_dot_fret': "quantum dot*"[tiab] AND protease*[tiab] AND (FRET[tiab] OR "energy transfer"[tiab])
pubmed query 'single_quantum_dot_nanosensor': "single quantum dot"[tiab] AND (nanosensor*[tiab] OR sensor*[tiab] OR detection[tiab])
pubmed query 'tirf_single_molecule': (TIRF[tiab] OR "total internal reflection fluorescence"[tiab]) AND "single molecule*"[tiab]
pubmed query 'tirf_penetration_depth': (TIRF[tiab] OR "total internal reflection fluorescence"[tiab]) AND ("penetration depth"[tiab] OR evanescent[tiab])
pubmed query 'cy5_fret': Cy5[tiab] AND FRET[tiab]
pubmed query 'quantum_dot_cy5': "quantum dot*"[tiab] AND Cy5[tiab]
pubmed query 'quantum_dot_biosensor': "quantum dot*"[tiab] AND (biosensor*[tiab] OR nanosensor*[tiab] OR nanoprobe*[tiab]) AND fluorescen*[tiab]
pubmed query 'forster_radius': "Forster distance"[tiab] OR "Forster radius"[tiab] OR "Förster distance"[tiab] OR "Förster radius"[tiab]
pubmed query 'streptavidin_quantum_dot': streptavidin[tiab] AND "quantum dot*"[tiab]
pubmed query 'renin_fluorogenic': renin[tiab] AND ("quantum dot*"[tiab] OR FRET[tiab] OR fluorogenic[tiab])
meta.about: Hardware numbers stated in the device's own paper, each with its paper id and exact sentence. Parameters the paper does not state are NOT_FOUND. The literature harvest (official APIs only) is kept for counts: other papers' values are not written until the user asks to 'add typical'.
meta.policy: values only from the device's own paper (coordinator instruction, 15 Nov 2026); NOT_FOUND parameters carry value objects with status NOT_STATED and value null

meta.dedup: by arXiv id, PMID and DOI (case-insensitive); a record found again keeps its first copy
meta.extraction: Text is normalised (LaTeX, Unicode and MEDLINE spellings of units, √Hz, °C, ×, ±, µ) on a copy that maps back to the original, so each quote and sentence is exact (whitespace runs collapsed; a PDF line break keeps its hyphen). A number counts only when its unit and the words next to it name the parameter (RULES in scripts/build_literature.py); bounds such as 'below', 'respectively' lists, areas or volumes where a length is meant, and values outside each parameter's plausible_range are rejected. In the device's own paper both ends of a stated range are kept.
meta.raw_cache: data/literature/raw/ (gzip of the exact response bytes; see raw/manifest.json); not in git (over 20 MB) and not in the public build
